//: Knight's Armament M110 Semi-Automatic Sniper System: 7.62x51 NATO, 20-inch barrel, AR-10/SR-25 pattern. The full-length Army SASS, longer and a touch heavier than the compact M110A1.
description: The M110 Semi-Automatic Sniper System, a 7.62 NATO precision rifle built on the Knight's Armament SR-25.  Its 20-inch match barrel and free-floating rail give a designated marksman accurate, rapid follow-up shots out past 800 meters.  Feeds from AR-10 pattern magazines.

//: Knight's Armament SR-25 / Mk 11 Mod 0: 7.62x51 NATO semi-auto precision rifle, 20-inch barrel. The Mk 11 is the Naval Special Warfare designation of the same rifle (cosmetic variant).
description: The Knight's Armament SR-25, an AR-10 pattern 7.62 NATO semi-automatic rifle prized by special operations marksmen for marrying near-bolt-gun accuracy to a fast semi-automatic action.  Feeds from AR-10 pattern magazines.

variants.description: A Knight's Armament SR-25, an AR-10 pattern 7.62 NATO semi-automatic precision rifle.
A Mk 11 Mod 0 - the Naval Special Warfare designation for the Knight's Armament SR-25 7.62 NATO semi-automatic sniper rifle.

//: Knight's Armament Light Assault Machine Gun: 5.56x45 NATO belt-fed, constant-recoil action, dramatically lighter (~4.3 kg) than the M249 it competes with. Feeds the same belts and STANAG mags.
description: The Knight's Armament Light Assault Machine Gun, a 5.56 NATO belt-fed weapon built around a constant-recoil action that tames muzzle climb and slashes weight to barely more than a loaded rifle.  It feeds from disintegrating belts or, in a pinch, STANAG magazines.

//: Colt 9mm SMG (Model 635 / RO635): 9x19mm select-fire submachine gun built by Colt on the M16 platform, as issued to U.S. forces. Feeds from Uzi-pattern magazines via a magazine-well adapter.
description: The Colt 9mm Submachine Gun, a compact select-fire 9x19mm weapon Colt built on the M16 platform for close-quarters work.  A magazine-well adapter lets it run reliable Uzi-pattern magazines, and its closed-bolt action makes it accurate and easy to control.  Familiar controls and select-fire give an operator a quiet, controllable bullet hose.
